Plot VDJ contig capture efficiency across neighbourhoods

Source: R/plot_capture_efficiency.R
plot_capture_efficiency.Rd

Generates two diagnostic plots summarising how efficiently VDJ contigs were captured across transcriptional neighbourhoods: a jittered boxplot of per-neighbourhood contig capture rate, and a scatterplot of contig count against neighbourhood size (with a linear fit) to check whether capture scales as expected with neighbourhood size.

Usage

plot_capture_efficiency(nhood_diversity_df, group_by = NULL)

Arguments

nhood_diversity_df

The neighbourhood-level metadata data frame generated as the output of nhood_diversity, containing at minimum the columns contig_capture_rate, n_contigs and nhood_size.

group_by

Character scalar giving the name of a column in nhood_diversity_df to colour/facet points by (e.g. cell type, timepoint, or tissue). If NULL (the default) or not found in colnames(nhood_diversity_df), all neighbourhoods are treated as a single "All" group.

Value

A named list of two ggplot nhood_diversity_dfs:

capture_rate

Jittered boxplot of contig_capture_rate by group_by, with point size scaled to nhood_size.

count_vs_size

Scatterplot of n_contigs against nhood_size, coloured by group_by, with a linear trend line.

Details

If group_by is supplied but is not already a factor, it is coerced to one internally; the input nhood_diversity_df itself is not modified. This function is purely a visualisation wrapper and does not perform any capture-rate calculation itself.

See also

nhood_diversity

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plots <- plot_capture_efficiency(nhood_meta, group_by = "cell_type")
plots$capture_rate
plots$count_vs_size
} # }
